contentList.content: You gain three Channel Divinity charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, allowing you to both <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TurnUndead">Pacify</LSTag> Undead foes, as well as trigger additional effects determined by your choice of subclass.
Utilized in prayer to divine various types of miracles.

Your god bestows gifts at random, projecting their power through you. Each turn while in combat, you have a 33% chance to experience <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>.
On your first turn of any combat encounter, you immediately experience <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>.

Once per combat, upon experiencing <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>, you immediately regain one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge.

Utilize your charge of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag> to produce a Miracle of your choice. Your Miracles grow stronger as you gain levels as a Cleric and change depending on your choice of subclass.
You channel your prayer in a time of need in order to experience an instance of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>.
You flow with limitless arcane energy. You recover a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> of the highest level you are capable of casting based on your levels in Cleric.
The power of your god erupts from within you, bathing all nearby enemies in a damaging radiance.
The anger of your god seeps out from within you, rotting all nearby enemies in putrid necrosis and afflicting them with a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PLAGUEOFROT">Curse of Rot</LSTag>.
The flame of your god seeps out from within you, forming a divine barrier over all nearby allies and granting them the effects of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_FireShield">Fire Shield</LSTag>.

The secrets of your god spill out from reality itself, damaging the minds of all nearby enemies and potentially afflicting them with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MIND_SLIVER">Mind Sliver</LSTag> for three turns.

The mercy of your god overflows from within you, soothing all nearby allies and granting them the effects of both <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_LesserRestoration">Latent Restoration</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GreaterRestoration">Great Cleanse</LSTag>.

The wrath of your god strikes from within you, thunderously jolting all nearby enemies. On a successful <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, the affected targets will take Thunder damage instead.
The warpath of your god marches ever forward around you, bathing all nearby enemies in wanton, war-driven radiance.
Feelings of soothing mercy flow from within, restoring the <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> of all nearby allies.
You and your allies become wreathed in a divine blessing, causing your <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> to gain a bonus equal to half your levels in Cleric for three turns.

Affected creature is wreathed in a divine blessing, causing their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> to gain a bonus equal to half the levels in Cleric of whomever applied this condition.
Pray for your god to pacify all nearby Undead, holding them still. Attacks made against them from within [1] will always be <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag>.
Affected creature is perfectly still, unable to act. Attacks made against them within [1] are always <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag>.

You nourish your faith on forces that make dealings in death, giving rise to desolate plague and putrid necrosis alike.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Gain the ability to detonate non Horde-Based corpses or Undead creatures, dealing Necrotic damage to all creatures in a [1] radius. The damage of Bursting Sinew cannot be increased.

When damaging an enemy, this action will always apply one stack of Curse of Rot.

Detonate a non Horde-Based corpse or Undead creature, dealing Necrotic damage to all creatures in a [1] radius. The damage of Bursting Sinew cannot be increased.

When damaging a creature, this action will always apply one stack of Curse of Rot.
Affected creature takes [1] at the end of each of their turns for each stack of Curse of Rot they have. At the end of each of their turns, they receive one additional stack.

Gain the ability to use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CURSEOFUNDEATH">Proclaim</LSTag> a creature as Undead, granting them <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Necrotic damage.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CURSEOFUNDEATH">Proclaim</LSTag> a creature as Undead, granting them <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Necrotic damage.
Affected creature is considered to be Undead. In addition, they have <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Necrotic damage.

While within [1] of a corpse, they radiate a necrotic aura, dealing [2] to all enemies within [3] at the end of each of their turns and preventing them from recovering Hit Points.

In addition, when the aura damages a creature suffering from a Curse of Rot, they receive one additional stack. This can be toggled at any time.

Affected corpse is radiating a necrotic aura, dealing [1] to all enemies within [2] at the end of each of their turns and preventing them from recovering Hit Points.

In addition, when the aura damages a creature suffering from a Curse of Rot, they receive one additional stack.

Affected creature is taking [1] at the end of each of their turns and cannot recover Hit Points.

If the affected creature is also suffering from a Curse of Rot, they receive one additional stack per turn.
When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore all forms of <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Necrotic damage.
At the beginning of each of their turns, creatures with a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PLAGUEOFROT">Curse of Rot</LSTag> spread it to their allies within [1] of them.
The first instance of Necrotic damage you deal to an enemy in a combat encounter causes your target to become <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to all damage for one turn.
Affected creature is <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to all damage for one turn.

Your faith sparks divine fire lit within the firmament of your belief, smelted in an act of holy ambition. A raging inferno held in hand to strike true and just.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Tank

Gain the ability to call a divine hammer to your hand. As you level within Cleric, it will deal additional damage and gain new effects.

In addition, when dealing damage to a non-allied target, you deal additional Fire damage equal to your levels in Cleric and generate one stack of Heat. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

Summon a forge hammer, capable of smelting even the hottest of embers. As you level in Cleric, it will deal additional damage and gain new effects.

Summoning your forge hammer may be done at any time as a free action.
Smelted within the realm of gods and forged by the hands of celestials, this hammer reacts to and grows with the strength of whomever wields it. Divine power can be felt emanating from within.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_MAG_Fire_Heat_Convergence_Passive">Heat Convergence</LSTag> is active, you make both <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
Dealing damage with this weapon causes a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Firebolt">Firebolt</LSTag> to target one other creature within [1] of you.

Gain the ability to expend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge in order to strike a target with divine conviction. Upon doing so, all creatures within [1] of you will erupt in a violent inferno, causing them to take the hit as well.
Strike a target with divine conviction. Upon doing so, all creatures within [1] of you will erupt in a violent inferno, causing them to take the hit as well.
Affected creature has been stricken with divine flame. All incoming <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> made against them are rolled with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

While wearing armour, you gain one of three unique effects, dependent on the type of armour worn.

Light armour grants the ability to ignore Resistances and Immunities when dealing Fire damage to an enemy or item.

Medium armour grants the ability to potentially experience an instance of Divine Intervention the first time that you deal Fire damage to an enemy each turn.

Heavy armour grants you the ability to generate one stack of Heat upon being damaged by an enemy, simultaneously dealing Fire damage to your aggressors equal to your levels in Cleric.
<LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="StrikingIron">Striking Iron</LSTag> now causes enemies affected to be attacked with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> for three turns.

Once per turn, upon reaching ten stacks of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FIRE_HEAT">Heat</LSTag>, you immediately gain a charge of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="StrikingIron">Striking Iron</LSTag> now causes enemies to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING_LAVA">Melt</LSTag> for three turns.

Your faith is one of occlusion and obscurity. Secrets forged in shadow, bound in rites which elude all but the most devout of followers.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Support

Directly targeting an ally with a Spell or Cantrip will cause them to become Invisible for three turns. This can be toggled at any time.

Additionally, upon causing a creature to become Invisible through Veilcasting, all enemies within [1] of them receive [2]. This damage increases alongside your levels in Cleric.

When an ally is damaged by an enemy, use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge to reflect the damage back to their aggeressor. In addition, you cause your ally to regain [2]. This <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> restored increases alongside your levels in Cleric.
When an ally is damaged by an enemy, reflect the damage back to their aggeressor. In addition, you cause your ally to regain [2].
Targeting an ally with a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> will cause you to become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag> as well.
Upon dealing Psychic damage to an enemy, you potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprise</LSTag> your target for one turn.
Gain the ability to swap places with an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag> ally as a free action.
Swap places with an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag> ally as a free action.
Creatures you <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprise</LSTag> become <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Psychic damage.

Tasked with the holy edict of preserving the body, mind, and soul, your god grants you a plethora of healing magics.

Suggested Role(s): Healer/Support
Upon healing another creature, the target regains additional <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to your level.
Evoke a healing radiance which restores your or an ally's <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> by your level multiplied by four.
When healing a creature, you also <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLESS">Bless</LSTag> them for three turns.
When you or an ally is about to receive elemental damage, you can use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> to halve the damage of the attack.
When you or an ally is about to receive elemental damage, halve the attack's damage.
While in combat, creatures within [1] of you regain the maximum <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> possible when healed.
Affected creature will regain the maximum <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> possible when healed while within [1] of the creature who applied this condition.

<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PreserveLife">Preserve Life</LSTag> is now able to target the corpses of fallen allies. Targeting a dead ally with Preserve Life will resurrect them with all of their <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.

Your faith has made you the very thunder that quakes the black firmament, the lightning coursing through the veins of a terrible storm.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create projectiles of Cold, Lightning, or Thunder. These projectiles jump to two other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all three targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create jagged shards of ice. These shards jump to two other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Cold damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all three targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create arcing bolts of Lightning. These bolts jump to two other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Lightning damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all three targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create booming spheres of Thunder. These spheres jump to two other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Thunder damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all three targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create projectiles of Cold, Lightning, or Thunder. These projectiles jump to all other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create jagged shards of ice. These shards jump to all other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Cold damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create arcing bolts of Lightning. These bolts jump to all other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Lightning damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all targets.

Once per action, when dealing damage to a creature, you create booming spheres of Thunder. These spheres jump to all other enemies within [1] of your target, dealing Thunder damage equal to your levels in Cleric to all targets.

When dealing Cold, Lightning or Thunder based damage, you may expend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge to maximize the damage dealt for that action.
When dealing Cold, Lightning or Thunder damage, maximize the damage dealt for that action.

Once per turn, you may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CreateWater">Create Water</LSTag> as a level one Spell as a free action. In addition, <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Discharge">Discharge</LSTag> now targets all enemies within [1] of you.
Affected creature may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CreateWater">Create Water</LSTag> as a level one Spell as a free action.

Using a charge of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag>, strike back at a creature who has damaged you within a range of [1], dealing Cold, Lightning, or Thunder damage equal to your level.
When an enemy damages you within a range of [1], retaliate with a strike of lightning that deals damage equal to your level.
When an enemy damages you within a range of [1], retaliate with a crash of thunder that deals damage equal to your level.
When an enemy damages you within a range of [1], retaliate with a frigid cold that deals damage equal to your level.
When you deal Cold, Lightning or Thunder damage to an enemy that is Large or smaller, you also push it away from where you stand by [1]. This effect can be toggled at any time.

When you deal Cold, Lightning or Thunder damage to an enemy, your target must succeed a Constitution based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag>.

Fortified by holy zeal, you brandish an arsenal of sacramental savagery to use against those you deem unrighteous.

Suggested Role(s): Damage
When dealing damage to a non-allied target, you deal an additional [1].

Bestow the glory of your god, using your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charge to grant either yourself or an ally within [1] a +[2] bonus to an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Gain a +[1] bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Grant an ally within [1] a +[2] bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
After using one of your Miracles, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage rolls for the rest of your turn.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage for the rest of their turn.
Gain the ability to make a weapon based attack against a target as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.
Make a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag> as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.
Make a <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">Ranged Weapon Attack</LSTag> as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.

When you utilize your War God's Blessing to succeed an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, the bonus to your Attack Rolls remains active for three turns and provides your ally with the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Radiant_Strikes">Radiant Strikes</LSTag>.
Affected character has a +10 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>. In addition, they benefit from <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Radiant_Strikes">Radiant Strikes</LSTag>.
Once per turn, after using one of your Miracles, your next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> will always roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
Affected creature's next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> will always roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Blessed be the Cleric who receives such gracious gifts from their deity.
A veritable sign commanding prayers become power.
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all Constitution based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> on a non-allied creature, emit an aura which <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLESS">Blesses</LSTag> yourself and all allies within [1] of you for three turns.
The first time you heal a creature each turn, the number you need to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> is reduced by 1. This effect will reset upon landing a Critical Hit.

Affected creature will roll <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag> more easily. The number required is reduced by 1 for each stack of Blood for Blood. This effect will reset once they have rolled a Critical Hit.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> on a non-allied creature, emit a healing aura across [1] which restores +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to yourself and all allies. This effect can trigger once per turn.
Increase your odds of experiencing instances of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag> from 33% to 50%.

At the end of any combat encounter, you emit a healing aura across [1] after three turns, which restores +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to yourself and all allies.

Affected creature will emit a healing aura across [1] after three turns, which restores +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by their <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to both themselves and all allies.
Permanently gain the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GUIDANCE">Guidance</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RESISTANCE">Resistance</LSTag>.

When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an ally within [1], you may use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> to retaliate with either <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ChillTouch">Bone Chill</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SacredFlame">Sacred Flame</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SparkSurge">Spark Surge</LSTag>.
When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an ally within [1], retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ChillTouch">Bone Chill</LSTag>.
When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an ally within [1], retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SacredFlame">Sacred Flame</LSTag>.
When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an ally within [1], retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SparkSurge">Spark Surge</LSTag>.
Upon healing a creature with a Spell, you gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on their next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
While below half of your total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>, you regain the maximum amount of Hit Points possible when healed.
Affected creature will regain the maximum amount of <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> possible when healed.

When an enemy damages you with a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, deal damage to them equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag> multiplied by two. The type of damage dealt changes depending on your choice of subclass.

When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, you may use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> and one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charges to receive <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLADE_WARD_IMMACULATE">Immaculate Blessed Ward</LSTag> for one turn.
When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, receive <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLADE_WARD_IMMACULATE">Immaculate Blessed Ward</LSTag> for one turn.
Affected creature is <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to the next instance of damage they would have suffered.
Upon being <LSTag Tooltip="Downed">Downed</LSTag> or killed within [1] of an enemy, erupt as a raging inferno, uncontrollably scorching them. The damage of this passive scales with your level.
Affected creature will erupt as a raging inferno upon being <LSTag Tooltip="Downed">Downed</LSTag> or killed while within [1] of an enemy, uncontrollably scorching them for [2].
After using one of your Miracles, you recover one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ChannelDivinity">Channel Divinity</LSTag> charges.
Upon healing a creature, potentially experience an instance of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="DivineIntervention">Divine Intervention</LSTag>. This may only occur once per turn.
At the beginning of each of your turns in combat, regain <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> multiplied by two.
During combat, emit an aura across [1] which provides <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SANCTUARY">Sanctuary</LSTag> to allies who are <LSTag Tooltip="Downed">Downed</LSTag>.
Permanently gain the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISPEL_EVIL_AND_GOOD">Dispel Evil and Good</LSTag>.
Gain status immunity to all forms of fear. Additionally, upon healing a creature with a Spell, they receive <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEATH_WARD">Death Ward</LSTag> for three turns.
After using one of your Miracles, you receive <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="VENERATION">Veneration</LSTag> for three turns.
Affected creature's main-hand weapon deals damage equal to their <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>. The type of damage dealt changes depending on their choice of subclass.
